scope: Fortnite physical events relevant to France and Europe

policy.canonical_key: event_uid + provider_id + session_key/category_key when granular tracking is useful

scarcity_evidence.EXPLICIT_TEXT: Direct source explicitly says low availability, nearly sold out or sold out.
scarcity_evidence.OFFICIAL_SESSION_DISABLED: The exact session is explicitly unavailable/sold out on official ticketing.
scarcity_evidence.CATEGORY_SOLD_OUT: A precise category is sold out but the event/session may still have other inventory.
scarcity_evidence.SEATMAP_STRONG_SIGNAL: Official seat-map signal; never enough alone for a strong global SOLD_OUT claim unless provider semantics are unambiguous.
scarcity_evidence.UNKNOWN: No scarcity proof; do not infer.

confidence.HIGH: Direct organizer/venue/ticketing source and exact event/session/category state.
confidence.MEDIUM: Official source but incomplete granularity or event-wide scope.
confidence.LOW: Useful signal only; cannot trigger strong scarcity transition.

policy.inventory_not_admission: Ticket inventory describes the ticket product only. Admission requirements, age, ID, check-in, re-entry, accessibility and last-entry are canonical in fortnite-physical-access-france.json.
policy.preregistration_semantics: PREREGISTRATION is not assumed to grant admission. The access ledger decides whether it is REGISTER_INTEREST or real attendance registration.
policy.global_vs_session: One SOLD_OUT session never makes a multi-session event globally SOLD_OUT while another known session is AVAILABLE/ON_SALE.
policy.category_rule: VIP/premium/2-day package sold out never means the entire event is sold out. Keep category_states separate.
policy.waiting_list_rule: WAITLIST is not automatically SOLD_OUT. Preserve WAITLIST as its own state and notify on BACK_ON_SALE if direct inventory returns.
policy.new_session_rule: Same physical event/run + new public session keeps event_uid and physical_event_id; add session state and update calendar only when the new session changes attendance planning.
policy.price_rule: Track direct published min/max/category prices. A missing cheaper category is not automatically a general price rise.
policy.capacity_rule: Ticket inventory count or venue capacity is stored only when the exact provider explicitly publishes it. Never derive remaining places from a seat map or venue capacity.

check_strategy.HOT: Event <=14 days, France/Paris priority, WAITLIST/SOLD_OUT, imminent sale or newly announced access: check each useful hourly run.
check_strategy.WARM: 15–60 days: at most every 6h unless a recent material signal exists.
check_strategy.COLD: >60 days: at most daily unless sale/venue/session announcement is expected.
check_strategy.LONG_RUN: Long convention/activation: daily overall, intensify around final days, special sessions or ticket transitions.

policy.write_noise: No commit for identical recheck, checked_at alone, category reorder or unchanged price/status.
policy.event_end: Normal EVENT_ENDED is silent unless an anomaly or actionable extension/cancellation occurred.

conditional.LOW_AVAILABILITY: Notify only for FEATURED/important event, France/Paris priority, near date or explicit strong evidence.
